patterns.name: Linked List (In-place Reversal)

patterns.name: Tries

patterns.name: Heap / Top-K Elements

patterns.name: Backtracking / Subsets

patterns.name: Graph Traversal (DFS/BFS)

patterns.name: Topological Sort

patterns.name: Union-Find / DSU
patterns.core_idea: Disjoint sets with union-by-rank + path compression.

patterns.name: Shortest Path (Dijkstra/Bellman-Ford)
patterns.core_idea: Relax edges to minimize weighted distance.

patterns.name: Minimum Spanning Tree
patterns.core_idea: Prim/Kruskal connect all nodes at minimum cost.

patterns.name: 1-D DP (Fibonacci-style)
patterns.core_idea: dp[i] derived from a few previous states.
patterns.recognize_when: ways-to / min-max along a sequence, robber-style.

patterns.name: Knapsack DP (0/1 & Unbounded)
patterns.core_idea: Include/exclude items under a capacity.

patterns.name: Grid / 2-D DP
patterns.core_idea: dp[i][j] over a matrix or two indices.
patterns.recognize_when: paths in a grid, two-sequence alignment.

patterns.name: LCS / String DP
patterns.core_idea: 2-D DP over two strings or a string vs itself.

patterns.name: Interval DP
patterns.core_idea: dp over a range, splitting at a pivot k.
patterns.recognize_when: merge/burst/cut on a line, game on a range.

patterns.name: DP on Trees
patterns.core_idea: Post-order DP returning per-subtree results.

patterns.name: Bitmask DP
patterns.core_idea: Compress a small set into an integer bitmask state.

patterns.name: Greedy
patterns.core_idea: Take the locally optimal choice; prove it's global.

patterns.name: Intervals / Line Sweep
patterns.core_idea: Sort by start/end, then merge or sweep.

patterns.name: Math & Geometry
patterns.core_idea: Number theory plus matrix-manipulation tricks.

patterns.name: Bit Manipulation
patterns.core_idea: XOR/AND/shift tricks; operator-free arithmetic.

patterns.name: Segment Tree / Fenwick (BIT)
patterns.core_idea: log-n range query with point/range update.

patterns.name: String Matching (KMP / Rabin-Karp / Z)
patterns.core_idea: Linear-time substring search via failure function/hashing.
patterns.recognize_when: find pattern in text, periodicity, anagram windows.

patterns.name: Misc (Quickselect / Reservoir / Game Theory)
patterns.core_idea: Specialized one-offs: partition-select, sampling, minimax.
patterns.recognize_when: kth element O(n) avg, random pick, optimal-play games.
